name: AcDisplayAsHyperlink
description: Used with the DisplayAsHyperlink property to specify whether to display the contents of a text box or combo box as a hyperlink.

constants.name: acDisplayAsHyperlinkAlways
constants.description: Always display the contents of the control as a hyperlink.

constants.name: acDisplayAsHyperlinkOnScreenOnly
constants.description: Display the contents of the control as a hyperlink only on the screen.
